sections.text:
The MBCZ10 bus bar protection is Modular, solid state, low impedance biased differential based on the circulating current principle and dual
cratered of operation, provides continuous supervision of CT secondary circuits and constant monitoring of vital circuits
extremely stable up to the Max switch gear.

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of the MBCZ10 relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on a yearly bases. This work be carried out section of this document is divided into 3 sections.

The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for testing describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests. The third section is the actual test.
The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

sections.text: Preliminary Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing

items: Review technical reference material, manufacturer manual.
Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.
Inspect the CT secondary circuits and all cabling supplying the relay.
Use the station drawing to isolate the disturbance alarm and fault, recorder associated with this relay. Breaker trip coils and also breaker failure scheme.

sections.text: Testing the Relay and Protection O/P

items: Carefully follow this test procedure from page 2 to page 4.
Verify the test results match the relay setting, if not consult technical services.
Test trip all breakers associated with the relay.

Block the trip O/P relay for a short period during the test.
Set the selection switch on the front of the test unit to inject X I and set the digital Current switch to 00.
Set the MAN/AUTO switch to MAN.
Set the current to 80% of the marked value of the selected setting and the relay should not indicate a trip.
Increase the current to the marked setting value and the protection should operate.
There should be a trip indication on the element begin tested and 2 protection operated.

sections.text: TEST Supervision for Isolator Repeat Relays

items: Switches off the power supply to the isolator repeat relay circuit.
The indicators for the isolator repeat relay supervision should light up, will be followed after a delay by an alarm indication on the modules containing the repeat relays.
The power fail alarm should also be initiated by the action of switching off the power Supply.

sections.text: Units for External Breaker Fail BZT Check

items: To test BZT relay first ensure that the key switch is a protection out, then bridge the BZT Contacts.
Check that the feeder under test and all the circuit breaker modules connected to the same Main zone and the alarm unite show a trip indication.
If the feeder is not connected to main zone (because all its isolators are open) check that Protection operated appears on the alarm unit followed by common alarm.

sections.text:
Feeder Units for Internal Breaker Fail
/ Feeder unit manufactured before Aug. 1989

items: For this test it is necessary for the feeder to be connected the bus bar or appear to the Scheme to be connected.
Note to which zone the connection or simulated connection is made.
Set the switch on phase c of the appropriate zone measuring unit to 0.5.
Inject current equal to 0.2 x-rated current / matching ratio in to terminals 21 and 22 of the feeder unit.
This should not cause any trip or protection operated indicators to light.
Bridge the breaker fail contact on the feeder protection.
Check that all the circuit breaker units on the relevant zone give a trip indication and the feeder unit under test shows a BACK trip as well.
Leave the breaker fail contact open.
Connect current injection to terminal 21 and 27 and link 22 and 28.

Set the check zone measuring unit phase C is to
 (0.5 In E) the same as the main zone.
Put the current setting of the breaker failure to 200mA.
Inject a current equal 0.2 rated current.

Check that a trip indication appears on the main and the circuit breaker units in the main
 zone followed by a back trip on the feeder unit under test.

items: Remove the plug test lead from the test module also from the measuring zone to be tested.
If any equipment with the relay has been isolate without the test plug, it should be returned to service.
